Name: Gaius of Macedonia
Summary: Gaius of Macedonia was one of Paul's travelling companions seized by the Ephesian mob and dragged into the theatre during the riot of the silversmiths. He is distinguished by his homeland from Gaius of Derbe.
KeyStory: Gaius of Macedonia was seized in the Ephesian riot and dragged with Aristarchus into the theatre.
LifeLesson: Companions share the mob as well as the mission. Gaius of Macedonia was dragged, not just inconvenienced.
